## What changed
Changed the repair-delivery discriminator in `scripts/shiki_loop.py` from "did the PR head move" to "did the repair change something the **implementer** owns."

- **`_loop_authored_repair_paths()`** (new) — the narrow, named set of `.shiki` paths the loop itself (re)writes into the worktree each cycle: the task's own mirror record `.shiki/tasks/<id>.json` (status/`cca_rerun_count`/`ledger_evidence`) plus the `.shiki/locks/<id>.json` and `.shiki/goals/<goal>.json` that `sync_contract_into_worktree` copies in before every session. Deliberately **not** all of `.shiki` — the code says so.
- **`_repair_implementer_changes()`** (new) — diffs the pushed commit range `head_before..head_after`, strips loop bookkeeping, and returns what the implementer actually changed. Returns `None` (→ proceed) when the per-push delta can't be scoped (a first push carries the whole branch = real delivery); `[]` (→ stop) when the head moved on bookkeeping alone.
- **New guard** in `execute_action`'s `dispatch_repair` branch, right after the existing head-movement check — same stop action, same reason shape, same position. Only the discriminator changed; the existing push-failure and head-did-not-advance branches are untouched.

Why the measured PR #310 loop happened: `_commit_and_push_implementation` does `git add -A`, so the runner-dispatch's rewrite of the task's own mirror record moved the head on every attempt even with zero source change — the old guard couldn't see it and burned all three attempts to `stop_guardian`. The new guard stops at attempt 1.

- **TDD:** `tests/test_repair_delivery.py` — 3 new tests (bookkeeping-only stops with the measured one-file `.shiki/tasks/<id>.json` fixture + one packet; source-only proceeds; both proceed); existing delivery-failure and head-did-not-move cases unchanged.
- **code-review:** self-reviewed — range diff is valid (non-FF push fails the earlier guard), `None` vs `[]` semantics verified, exclusion is narrow.

- Chained `test_command` exit 0. Only the two locked files edited (`scripts/shiki_loop.py`, `tests/test_repair_delivery.py`).
